# Исправления

## 2026-09-24 — AI-чат собирает видео на GitHub-ранере и кнопка «Видео»

- Агент получил инструмент `gen_video`: текстовая анимация или слайд-шоу из картинок собираются ngpython+ffmpeg на ubuntu-раннере GitHub (новый workflow `video-runner.yml`) и приходят в чат готовым файлом `videos/*.mp4` с кнопкой «Отправить». Нужен PAT-токен из настроек вкладки AI — тот же, что для раннер-чата.
- Режим «слайд-шоу» принимает URL картинок (например, уже сгенерированные через `gen_image` на pollinations.ai): ранер скачивает кадры и склеивает видео с медленным наездом; режим «текст» рисует анимированный заголовок и заголовок-бегущую строку.
- Ранер не исполняет произвольный код из запроса: текст только рисуется на кадрах, картинки скачиваются по ссылке — запрос не может стать командой на ранере.
- В чате появилась кнопка «Видео» рядом с «Картинка»/«Аудио»/«Zip» — подставляет заготовку запроса.
- `AiChatToolsTest` дополнен проверкой `gen_video`: имя в реестре, защита от подмены плагином, документация ровно один раз, упоминание GitHub-ранера.

## 2026-09-24 — AI-чат генерирует звук и меняет голоса, бонусом — кнопки генерации

- Агент научился озвучивать в файл: `render_audio` (Edge TTS, бесплатно, без ключа) пишет MP3 в `workspace/audio/`, и готовый файл сразу появляется в чате с именем, размером и кнопкой «Отправить», как и картинки. Раньше озвучка была только «на лету» (кнопка «Озвучить»), готового аудиофайла агент не создавал.
- Тестирование голосов прямо из чата: `voice_list` показывает текущий голос и каталог Edge-голосов, `voice_preview` сразу проигрывает пробу выбранного («Привет! Это тест голоса…»), `voice_set` запоминает выбор в те же настройки озвучки, что и экраны приложения — послушал, не понравилось, попросил заменить, и голос сменён.
- Новые имена закрыты от подмены самодельным плагином (`AiPlugins.RESERVED_TOOL_NAMES`), как и инструменты читалки.
- В чате над полем ввода появились быстрые кнопки генерации: «Картинка» и «Аудио» подставляют заготовку запроса, «Zip» одним тапом упаковывает workspace и показывает готовый архив — всё создаётся в чате и приходит готовым.
- Инструменты вынесены в `AiChatTools` (аналог `AiReaderTools`), покрыты `AiChatToolsTest`: уникальность имён, защита от плагинов, документация каждого инструмента ровно один раз в системном промпте.

## 2026-09-24 — AI-чат отдаёт кнопки-варианты [[...]]

- Ответы AI, в конце которых модель предложила варианты действий (строки вида `[[Текст]]`, до 4), теперь показывают эти варианты кнопками под сообщением: тап отправляет текст варианта как новую реплику. Раньше системный промпт обещал «они превратятся в кнопки под сообщением», а `AgentReply.choices` разбирался, но нигде не показывался.
- Разметка `[[...]]` убирается из текста ответа, сами тексты вариантов не теряются.
- Варианты сохраняются в истории книги (поле `choices` в `Msg`) и остаются после перезахода в чат; старые файлы истории без этого поля читаются без ошибок.
- Разбор вынесен в `AiAgent.parseChoices`/`stripChoices` (был инлайн-код в `run()`) и покрыт `AiChoicesTest`: до 4 вариантов, пустой список, очистка разметки, round-trip сериализации и совместимость со старыми файлами.

## 2026-09-24 — AI-чат показывает, что он делает, и отдаёт файлы

- В шапке чата теперь видно подключение: выбранный бэкенд, провайдер и причина недоступности («нет сети», «нужен ключ», «нет сессии ранера»), а не просто надпись «AI-чат».
- Пока идёт ход, видно конкретный статус: «Запрос к модели…», «Инструменты: web_search, web_fetch», «Инструменты выполнены, жду ответ модели…» и таймер в секундах — понятно, что процесс живой, даже если модель думает долго.
- Размышления модели больше не теряются: у каждого ответа AI есть свёрнутый блок «Размышления».
- Список выполненных инструментов виден у ответа: название, время, ошибка ли была, какой файл создан и его размер.
- Файлы, созданные агентом, теперь перечислены прямо под ответом с именем, размером и кнопкой «Отправить» — системное меню позволяет отдать их в Telegram, сохранить или открыть.
- Размер и путь файла показываются сразу при создании, то есть видно, сколько уже сгенерировано, ещё до того, как модель закончит писать текст.
- Всё это сохраняется вместе с сообщением в истории книги: после перезахода чата размышления, инструменты и файлы остаются на месте.
- Добавлен `AiWorkspace.relPathOrNull` — файл попадает в список только если он действительно лежит внутри workspace.

## 2026-09-24 — AI управляет читалкой и помнит твои советы

- Агент получил действия над открытой книгой: `speak_page` (озвучить текущую страницу), `speak_chapter` (озвучивать всю главу с листанием), `stop_speak`, `page_text` (распознать текст текущей страницы) и `page_count`.
- Поэтому в чате теперь работают просьбы вида «прочитай всю главу», «озвучь страницу», «прочитай текущую страницу», «перескажи» и «сделай диалог ролей»: агент вызывает действия читалки и отвечает по фактическому тексту страницы, а не по догадкам.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Put a local HTTP port on the public internet, with no account and no token.
#
# WHY CLOUDFLARE AND NOT NGROK
#   ngrok's free plan allows one tunnel per account, so two desks - Linux and
#   Windows side by side - could never both be reachable. It also wants an
#   authtoken, which is one more secret to keep alive. cloudflared's quick
#   tunnels need neither: no account, no login, as many as you start.
#
#   Measured before this was written, in this workspace, not assumed:
#     * a quick tunnel came up in about 12 seconds and served a file over it
#     * a WebSocket service behind it completed an upgrade (HTTP 101)
#     * no X-Frame-Options and no CSP frame-ancestors on the response, so the
#       panel can show the desk in an iframe
#
#   The cost is an address that changes every session. That is why the panel
#   reads the address from session.json instead of anyone memorising it.
#
# Usage: open_tunnel.sh <local-port> [log-file]
# Prints the https URL on stdout, or nothing and exit 1.

set -uo pipefail

PORT="${1:?usage: open_tunnel.sh <local-port> [log]}"
LOG="${2:-/tmp/cloudflared-$PORT.log}"

if ! command -v cloudflared >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -sL --retry 3 -o /tmp/cloudflared \
    https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-linux-amd64
  chmod +x /tmp/cloudflared
  sudo mv /tmp/cloudflared /usr/local/bin/cloudflared 2>/dev/null || {
    mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; mv /tmp/cloudflared "$HOME/.local/bin/cloudflared"
    export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
  }
fi

nohup cloudflared tunnel --url "http://localhost:$PORT" \
  --no-autoupdate --loglevel info > "$LOG" 2>&1 &
echo $! > "/tmp/cloudflared-$PORT.pid"

# Poll rather than sleep for a fixed span: the tunnel is usually up in ten
# seconds but occasionally takes thirty, and a fixed wait either wastes time or
# reports a failure that was only slowness.
URL=""
for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
  sleep 2
  URL=$(grep -o 'https://[a-z0-9-]*\.trycloudflare\.com' "$LOG" | head -1)
  [ -n "$URL" ] && break
done

if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
  echo "open_tunnel: no address after 80s" >&2
  tail -20 "$LOG" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# The address exists before the edge is ready to serve it; a client that opens
# it too early gets a 502 and thinks the desk is broken. Wait for a real answer.
for _ in $(seq 1 20); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m 10 "$URL/" || true)
  case "$code" in 2*|3*|4*) break ;; esac
  sleep 3
done

echo "$URL"

parts.text:
I have enough. Let me verify a couple more targeted things for `file:line` precision:

- release.yml top-level permissions absent (confirmed no `permissions:` near top; only job-level at line 184). The `build` job at line 28 lacks permissions block.
- build.yml `paths` trigger no push (line 5 on: workflow_dispatch, pull_request).
- `app/build.gradle.kts` signingConfig = debug.signingConfig (line 114).
- `getBuildTime` non-reproducible.
- `app/src/main/baselineProfiles/baseline-prof.txt` + startup-prof committed (generated).
- `.gitignore` doesn't ignore `dictionaries/` zips.
- `data/src/main/java/mihon/data/ocr/Vocab.kt` 6149 lines generated.
- Unpinned actions list with line numbers.
- `build-hub-snapshot.yml` lines 34-136 executes snapshot code with signing key.
- `opencode.yml` secrets lines.
- `llm-runner.yml` unpinned cloudflared/ttyd latest.
- `settings.gradle.kts` jitpack line 7, 25.
- `gradle.properties` lines 1, 19, 22, 25, 26.
- lint abortOnError false lines 215-218.
- `gradle/build-logic/gradle.properties` configureondemand line 6.

Let me quickly confirm whether `:app` androidTest and `:data` androidTest are ever run and whether there's a build-logic `Commands` git usage. Also confirm `mihon.versions.toml` android-sdk-compile = 37 (a non-existent/unstable SDK? In 2026 compileSdk 37 could exist). target=36, min=26. Fine.

One more: `app/build.gradle.kts` line 405 `onVariants(selector().withFlavor("default" to "standard"))` but no flavors/dimensions are defined (no productFlavors). So this selector likely matches nothing → dead code. Actually with no flavors, `withFlavor("default","standard")` matches the default/standard implicit? In AGP, variants without flavors still have "default" flavor? No — `withFlavor` matches when flavor dimension exists. Since build.gradle doesn't declare flavors, this is dead. Minor finding.

Also `preview` and `benchmark` build types add `src/debug/res`; fine.

Also `signingConfig = debug.signingConfig` and the `if (!storeFileBase64.isNullOrBlank())` writes base64-decoded keystore to `RUNNER_TEMP/antsy.keystore`. This runs at configuration time and decodes env. Fine.

Now check the `release.yml` build job does not set `permissions` and thus inherits default; and the workflow has `env: MIHON_GITHUB_RELEASE: true`. Also it passes secrets to a gradle build that runs repo code. And `release.yml` uses `sh gradlew` (line 67) while build.yml uses `./gradlew`.

Also duplicate release: `release-universal.yml` similarly.

Let me also check that `build.yml` is named "Tests" but doesn't run on push to default branch, and no release gate. And `pull_request` only. Good.

Let me confirm the `emulator-smoke.yml` uses `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN` in a workflow triggered by workflow_dispatch with `tag` input — user can specify an arbitrary tag but gh release download uses token. Fine.

Now, is there a `release.yml` reliance on `github.repository ==` guard meaning forks can't run, but workflow_dispatch on the main repo can be triggered by anyone with write. Fine.

I should also verify `data` module's androidTest file and whether CI runs it. It doesn't.

Let me also check `CHANGES.md` vs `CHANGELOG.md` duplication — two changelogs, different content, one small (CHANGELOG) one huge (CHANGES). Repo hygiene.

Also `ADVANCED_IMPROVEMENTS_2.md`, `AUDIT_YOMIKAI_ADVANCED.md` are prior audit docs committed. `AGENT_SESSION.md` (61KB), `todo.md` (60KB). Stray.

I think I have enough. Let me do one final check: verify whether `baseline-profile` module is actually used and whether its tests exist; and confirm `presentation-widget`, `telemetry`, `core-metadata` build files for test config. Not strictly needed.

Let me also verify the `android.enableProguardInReleaseBuilds` is genuinely a dead property. It's not in AGP. The upstream Tachiyomi used it as an ext property. Since the build uses `isMinifyEnabled=true`, R8 runs. The property `android.enableProguardInReleaseBuilds=false` is a no-op (AGP ignores it). But `android.enableR8.fullMode=false` is honored.

Actually wait — is `android.enableR8.fullMode=false` even valid now? In AGP 8+, fullMode defaults true and the flag still exists. In AGP 9 (android-gradle=9.2.1), it may be removed. Given AGP 9.2.1, `android.enableR8.fullMode` might be obsolete/removed — then it's also a no-op. Either way it's dead/misleading. I'll phrase: "legacy/no-op flag; R8 full mode isn't actually disabled under AGP 9, or it silently reduces optimization — verify."

Hmm, I should be careful with claims. Let me phrase findings grounded in what's in the file: the flags are set; `isMinifyEnabled=true` in app. The comment "Disable unnecessary features for faster builds" suggests the author believed proguard is disabled, but minify is on. So the mismatch is the finding.

Also note: `android.nonTransitiveRClass=false` — explicitly disables non-transitive R classes, contrary to AGP default (true since AGP 8). Increases build/resource overhead. Real.

Let me also double check the `app/build.gradle.kts` `lint { abortOnError=false; checkReleaseBuilds=false }` and no CI lint. Confirmed no CI lint.

Now compose the audit grouped by severity, each bullet with file:line and one-line fix. Let me be precise and concise.

Let me verify a few line numbers I'll cite:
- build-hub-snapshot.yml: workflow_dispatch only (line 11), fetches snapshot (34-114), signing key step 115-127, `uses: actions/setup-java@v5` 129, `gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4` 133, `assembleRelease` 136, upload `@v4` 143.
- opencode.yml permissions contents: write 46-47; secrets 88-96/222-230; checkout@v4 55/190; setup-node@v4 61/196; GH_TOKEN PAT comment 8-10; npm install main code 80-84/215-218; tunnel 117/248; keep alive 158-171.
- llm-runner.yml permissions contents: read 41-42; custom_url input 25-29; cloudflared latest 138-142; ttyd latest 157-160; actions/cache@v4 76,111,237,272; endpoint artifact 191-197; api key gen 122.
- release.yml: no top-level permissions (after line 7); build job line 28 no permissions; signing env 68-73; assembleRelease 67; comment no tests 60-63; release job permissions 184-185.
- release-universal.yml: tag trigger 17-19; signing env 85-91; release perms 161-162; no test gate.
- build.yml: triggers 5-14 (no push); dependency review continue-on-error 37-40; duplicate OCR test 57-59 then full test 61-63; path '**' line 9.
- video-runner.yml: checkout@v4 37, setup-python@v5 40, upload@v4 170; workflow_dispatch only 4; image URL fetch 133-141.
- emulator-smoke.yml: GH_TOKEN 44; upload @v4.3.3 120; workflow_dispatch 4.
- update_website.yml: `if: false` 12-13; MIHON_BOT_TOKEN 22; release trigger 4-8.
- gradle.properties: nonTransitiveRClass 1; enableR8.fullMode 19; enableProguardInReleaseBuilds 22; configuration-cache.problems=warn 26.
- build-logic/gradle.properties: configureondemand 6.
- settings.gradle.kts: jitpack 7,25.
- libs.versions.toml: compose-bom-alpha line 100; alpha/rc versions lines 8,10,33,64; commit-hash versions 45,46,70,77,79,82; jitpack modules; conscrypt 36; rxJava 72.
- app/build.gradle.kts: isMinifyEnabled 111-112; signingConfig=debug 114; isProfileable 116; lint 215-218; withFlavor dead 405; manifest mutation hack 412-441.
- Commands.kt: getBuildTime now() 33.
- keystore: app/keystore/release.p12 committed, google-services.json.
- dictionaries/*.zip tracked.
- Vocab.kt 6149 lines, FastVocabPart 5009/4424, RuWordList 2510.
- baseline-prof.txt 3.6MB, startup-prof.txt 2.9MB.
- test counts per module.

Also duplication: app contains data-layer packages `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/data/{ai,tts,ocr,books,dictionary,voice}` while `:data` also has `mihon/data/ocr`, `tachiyomi/data/*`. So layering inversion/duplication.

Also `data` depends on `domain` (data/build.gradle.kts:39) — direction data→domain is expected (data implements domain interfaces), not inversion. But `domain` depends on `source-api` and `core.common`; `data` also. Not an inversion. The user asked "whether data depends on app (inversion)" — answer: No, no module depends on `:app` (it's the terminal module). I'll note that as a positive finding? They said report only problems. I can state "no inversion found" briefly but they want problems. I'll mention it under architecture as a checked-and-clear item only if concise. Better to focus on problems.

Let me also check whether `core-metadata` and `telemetry` are effectively dead. `core-metadata` used by app and source-local. `telemetry` used by app. Not dead. `baseline-profile` used by app. Fine.

One more: the `i18n` module uses moko-resources and has huge per-locale strings; no tests. Not a big deal.

Let me quickly verify androidTest invocation absence and whether `data` build has testInstrumentationRunner. It has androidTestImplementation deps but the library plugin may not set runner; app sets it. Fine.

I think I should also check `gradlew` uses `sh gradlew` in release — the file is executable and has shebang; fine.

Now, severity ranking:

CRITICAL:
1. Committed signing keystore `app/keystore/release.p12` (real PKCS12) at repo root path — public signing key leak. Fix: remove, rotate key, gitignore.
2. `build-hub-snapshot.yml` executes unreviewed snapshot code from another repo/branch and injects signing key, builds signed release. Fix: delete/require manual approval + pin commit.
3. `opencode.yml` exposes a public remote shell (Cloudflare tunnel) with a full-access PAT + 8 API keys to anyone with the artifact URL, no auth (`api_key: ""`). Fix: remove or gate with auth+environment approval+minimal token.
4. `llm-runner.yml`/`opencode.yml` publish endpoint artifacts containing API keys; hub has no auth. Maybe fold into #3.

HIGH:
5. `release.yml` explicitly removed test gates before release (60-63) and lacks `permissions` on build job (28) while passing signing secrets.
6. `build.yml` doesn't run on push to main (only PR + dispatch, lines 5-14) → direct pushes bypass tests; no lint/spotless/connectedAndroidTest gate.
7. `app/keystore/release.p12` + `google-services.json` committed (google API key). (Maybe combine with #1.)
8. `release-universal.yml` same untested signed-release path, plus separate competing release path.
9. JitPack + commit-hash/`latest` dependency resolution and unpinned `cloudflared`/`ttyd` downloads (llm-runner 138-142, 157-160) — mutable supply chain.
10. `android.enableR8.fullMode=false` + `isMinifyEnabled=true` mismatch; `enableProguardInReleaseBuilds=false` dead flag; `nonTransitiveRClass=false` (gradle.properties 1,19,22).
11. Unpinned actions in 4 workflows.

MEDIUM:
12. config cache `problems=warn` (gradle.properties 26); configure-on-demand in build-logic (line 6).
13. Non-reproducible builds (`getBuildTime` now(), Commands.kt:33; BUILD_TIME, COMMIT_COUNT).
14. Lint disabled (app 215-218); no CI lint/spotless.
15. androidTest never executed in CI (2 files).
16. God classes / layering: app data packages + huge files.
17. Zero-test modules (8).
18. Committed generated word lists Vocab.kt etc.
19. Outdated alpha/RC deps and conscrypt 2.6.0, RxJava 1.3.8.
20. Committed dictionaries (50MB) & baseline profiles.
21. `withFlavor("default","standard")` dead selector (app 405); manifest-mutation doFirst hack (412-441).
22. Unpinned/obsolete `android.enableProguardInReleaseBuilds` misleading comment.
23. `emulator-smoke` older action pin; inconsistent.

LOW:
24. Stray docs (AGENT_SESSION.md, todo.md, CHANGES.md vs CHANGELOG.md, prior AUDIT md).
25. build-logic gradle.properties not synced (comment says should).
26. `update_website.yml` disabled job with secret.
27. `video-runner.yml` arbitrary image fetch + unpinned.

# Yomikai build/CI/architecture audit

## Critical

- **Release signing key committed to the repo** — `app/keystore/release.p12` (real PKCS#12, 2706 B, added in `4016ee4`). Anyone with repo read can forge updates. Fix: rotate the key, delete the file, add `*.p12` to `.gitignore`.
- **`build-hub-snapshot.yml` executes unreviewed code with the signing key** — `.github/workflows/build-hub-snapshot.yml:34-114` restores an arbitrary snapshot from `raw.githubusercontent.com/sj0404-collab/zen-panel/work-backup` (a different repo/branch, unpinned, includes uncommitted edits/untracked files), then `:115-127` fetches `keystore.properties`+`release.p12` and `:136` runs `assembleRelease`. Fix: delete this workflow or require a protected Environment + pin the snapshot SHA.
- **`opencode.yml` exposes an unauthenticated public remote shell with a full-access PAT and 8 API keys** — `.github/workflows/opencode.yml:46-47` (`contents: write`), `:88-96`/`:222-230` inject `YP_AGENT_TOKEN` (PAT for all repos per comment `:8-10`) plus OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/DeepSeek/OpenRouter/HF keys, `:117`/`:248` publish a Cloudflare tunnel, endpoint written with `"api_key": ""` (`:135`), and the endpoint (`:150-156`) is a downloadable artifact. `npm install` runs code from `main` (`:80-84`). Fix: remove the public tunnel/no-auth hub or gate behind a protected Environment with an expiring, minimal token and per-session auth.
- **Endpoint artifacts leak live model credentials** — `.github/workflows/llm-runner.yml:172-197` writes `api_key`/`tunnel` into `endpoint.json` and uploads it as an artifact; `opencode.yml:150-156` does the same with `api_key: ""`. Anyone with repo access can use the endpoint. Fix: don't persist keys in artifacts; deliver via a short-lived secret store.

## High

- **Release builds have no test gate** — `.github/workflows/release.yml:60-63` deliberately removed OCR/tests before `assembleRelease` (`:67`); the "Tests" workflow only runs on PR/dispatch (`build.yml:5-14`). A tag push ships untested code. Fix: add `needs: test`/require a green check on the tagged commit.
- **`release.yml` build job has no least-privilege `permissions` and runs repo code with signing secrets** — no top-level `permissions` (lines 1-14); `build` job (`:28`) lacks a block; secrets passed at `:68-73`. Default token perms + secrets + arbitrary build scripts. Fix: add `permissions: contents: read` to `build` and restrict secrets to a protected environment.
- **Second, competing signed-release path with same gaps** — `.github/workflows/release-universal.yml:17-19` (`universal-v*`), `:85-91` secrets, `:157-162`; no test gate, no top-level permissions. Fix: consolidate into one release workflow with a shared, tested gate.
- **No layout/format/lint enforcement in CI** — spotless is configured (`gradle/build-logic/src/main/kotlin/PluginSpotless.kt`) but no workflow runs `spotlessCheck`/`lint`; lint is disabled in the app (`app/build.gradle.kts:215-218`: `abortOnError=false`, `checkReleaseBuilds=false`). Fix: add `./gradlew spotlessCheck lint` to `build.yml` and set `abortOnError=true`.
- **R8/minify configuration contradicts its comments and limits optimization** — `gradle.properties:19` `android.enableR8.fullMode=false` while `app/build.gradle.kts:111-112` enables `isMinifyEnabled`/`isShrinkResources`; `gradle.properties:22` `android.enableProguardInReleaseBuilds=false` is a no-op (AGP ignores it) yet the comment says builds are faster; `gradle.properties:1` `android.nonTransitiveRClass=false` disables the modern R-class optimization. Fix: drop both dead flags, re-enable R8 full mode and non-transitive R classes.
- **Unpinned third-party binaries / actions in credential-bearing jobs** — `llm-runner.yml:138-142,157-160,298-300,314-316` download `cloudflared` and `ttyd` from `/releases/latest/` with no checksum; `actions/cache/{restore,save}@v4` (`:76,111,237,272`); `build-hub-snapshot.yml:129,133,143` `@v5/@v4`; `opencode.yml:55,61,190,196`; `video-runner.yml:37,40,170`. Fix: pin all actions to commit SHAs (Renovate already has `pinDigests: true`, `renovate.json5`) and the binaries to a version+checksum.
- **Mutable JitPack dependency surface** — `settings.gradle.kts:7,25` adds JitPack to both plugin and dependency resolution; many artifacts resolved from it (`libs.versions.toml:139,145-148,190,203,206,197,90,180`). Fix: mirror/vendor these or consume fixed artifacts from Maven Central.
- **Committed Firebase config exposes project identifiers/API key** — `app/google-services.json` tracked (`project_number`, `current_key` at lines 3-18). Fix: remove from VCS and inject in CI.

## Medium
